clean_source_blocks.text: Substance abuse was listed as another significant condition the former child star was experiencing.

Daveigh Chase, the horror actress who crawled out of a TV in The Ring and voiced Lilo in Disney's animated Lilo & Stitch, died this month from Aids, according to a medical examiner's report. Chase, who also voiced Chihiro in the English version of Spirited Away and starred in the cable drama Big Love, passed away at a hospital on 16 June at the age of 35. The Los Angeles County Medical Examiner, which listed "chronic polysubstance use" - defined as the use of multiple drugs simultaneously - under "other significant conditions", ruled her death to be "natural". Chase's manager, John Ryan Jr, told BBC News last week that she died from sepsis after suffering from meningitis in an LA hospital. The Ring and Lilo & Stitch actress Daveigh Chase dies aged 35

The Los Angeles County Medical Examiner has confirmed the cause of death for actor Daveigh Chase, best known as the voice of Lilo in Disney's 'Lilo & Stitch' and as Samara Morgan in 'The Ring'. Records released by the medical examiner show Chase — who also used the name Daveigh Schwallier — died on 16 June in Los Angeles from Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome (AIDS). The report lists "chronic polysubstance use" as a significant contributing condition and rules the death natural. Initial reports had named other serious health problems. Her boyfriend, Roy Hernandez, told TMZ she had been suffering from meningitis and a bloodstream infection that led to sepsis, and he set up a GoFundMe during her final days describing the hardships she faced.

[Lähde: BBC World]
Daveigh Chase, the horror actress who crawled out of a TV in The Ring and voiced Lilo in Disney's animated Lilo & Stitch, died this month from Aids, according to a medical examiner's report.

Chase, who also voiced Chihiro in the English version of Spirited Away and starred in the cable drama Big Love, passed away at a hospital on 16 June at the age of 35.

The Los Angeles County Medical Examiner, which listed "chronic polysubstance use" - defined as the use of multiple drugs simultaneously - under "other significant conditions", ruled her death to be "natural".

Chase's manager, John Ryan Jr, told BBC News last week that she died from sepsis after suffering from meningitis in an LA hospital.

The Ring and Lilo & Stitch actress Daveigh Chase dies aged 35

Chase's father, John David Schwallier, told the New York Times at the time of her death that she had been homeless and living in Los Angeles with her boyfriend before her passing.

The former child star, who was also known as Daveigh Schwallier, began acting at four years old, booking her first Hollywood job when she was seven, but she retired from acting full time in 2015, her manager said.

Her first TV role in Hollywood at age seven was a small part in the popular Melissa Joan Hart-led sitcom Sabrina the Teenage Witch.

Chase's Hollywood breakthrough came in 2001 when she appeared as Samantha Darko in Donnie Darko and later played the titular character's sister in the 2009 film S Darko.

In 2002, Chase starred as Samara Morgan, the long-haired ghost that crawls out of the telly in the horror film The Ring, an American remake of the Japanese classic about a videotape that makes people die after they watch it.

She earned a 2003 MTV Movie Award for best villain for her turn as the spooky demon-like character that crawls on its hands and feet before killing victims.

Also in 2002, she voiced the Elvis-adoring Hawaiian girl Lilo in the animated hit Lilo & Stitch.

The part earned her an Annie Award for best voice acting in an animated feature production and she continued to voice the character in spin-offs.

According to the Hollywood Reporter, Chase had a slew of legal run-ins later in life, including being charged with drug possession and joyriding in a stolen car.

payload.title: Näyttelijä Daveigh Chasen kuolinsyy vahvistui AIDSiksi
payload.summary: Los Angelesin piirikunnan oikeuslääkärin mukaan 35-vuotiaana kuollut Daveigh Chase menehtyi AIDSiin. Chase tunnettiin muun muassa Lilon äänenä elokuvassa Lilo & Stitch ja Samara Morganin roolista kauhuelokuvassa The Ring.
payload.content:
Los Angelesin piirikunnan oikeuslääkärin asiakirjojen mukaan näyttelijä Daveigh Chase kuoli AIDSiin 16. kesäkuuta Los Angelesissa. 35-vuotias Chase tunnettiin erityisesti Lilon ääniroolista Disneyn animaatiossa Lilo & Stitch sekä Samara Morganin roolista kauhuelokuvassa The Ring.

## Oikeuslääkäri luokitteli kuoleman luonnolliseksi

Oikeuslääkärin raportissa kuolinsyyksi on merkitty acquired immunodeficiency syndrome eli AIDS. Raportin mukaan kuolema luokiteltiin luonnolliseksi. Asiakirjoissa mainitaan myös krooninen useiden päihteiden samanaikainen käyttö muuna merkittävänä terveydentilaan vaikuttaneena seikkana.

Merkintä ei muuta raportin pääasiallista kuolinsyytä, mutta se kirjattiin kuolemaan liittyneeksi merkittäväksi olosuhteeksi. Oikeuslääkärin tiedot vahvistavat kuolinsyyn sen jälkeen, kun Chasen terveydentilasta oli aiemmin kerrottu julkisuudessa muiden vakavien sairauksien kautta.

## Aiemmat tiedot kertoivat infektioista

Chasen manageri John Ryan Jr kertoi BBC:lle viime viikolla, että Chase oli kuollut sepsikseen sairastettuaan aivokalvontulehdusta losangelesilaisessa sairaalassa. Myös Chasen poikaystävä Roy Hernandez oli kertonut TMZ:lle, että Chase kärsi aivokalvontulehduksesta ja verenkiertoinfektiosta, joka johti sepsikseen.

Hernandez oli lähdetietojen mukaan perustanut GoFundMe-keräyksen Chasen viimeisten päivien aikana ja kuvannut tämän kohtaamia vaikeuksia. Al.comin mukaan Chase oli ollut aiemmin saman kuukauden aikana sairaalahoidossa aliravitsemuksen vuoksi.

## Lapsitähti muistetaan tunnetuista rooleista

Chase nousi laajaan tunnettuuteen lapsinäyttelijänä. Hän antoi äänen Lilo-hahmolle Disneyn animaatioelokuvassa Lilo & Stitch ja esiintyi The Ring -kauhuelokuvassa Samara Morganina, hahmona, joka muistetaan elokuvan tunnetuimmista kohtauksista.

Chasen rooleihin kuului myös Chihiron ääni englanninkielisessä versiossa Hayao Miyazakin animaatioelokuvasta Henkien kätkemä. Lisäksi hän näytteli kaapelikanavan draamasarjassa Big Love. Lähdetietojen mukaan Chase käytti myös nimeä Daveigh Schwallier.
